chapters.label: Live: EURO 2026
chapters.text: The 2026 Futsal EURO quarter-final, in Ljubljana. Spain play Italy. Antonio Pérez is Spain’s fixo, the last defender. He scores twice, and Spain win four nil!

chapters.label: How he defends
chapters.text: The fixo reads the game. This is how he defends: he stays between the attacker and his goal, and watches the passer’s hips. The pass comes. He steps in front, steals it and goes!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Read the pass, step in, steal it, go!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when you are the last defender, read the pass and step in to steal it!
